title: pl-pii-bench v1.0.0
source_split: core, identifiers, address, negative and inflection lanes (all documents)
sample_rule: per language, rows ordered by sha256('<seed>:<uid>'), first n convertible

label_mapping.label: ORG
label_mapping.note: ORGANIZATION is a keep type: scored for recall, never a leak

label_mapping.label: PESEL
label_mapping.note: national identifiers and identity documents are ID_DOCUMENT

label_mapping.label: NIP
label_mapping.note: a tax number; a sole trader's NIP identifies a person

label_mapping.label: LOC
label_mapping.note: a LOC with a digit (a street address)

label_mapping.label: LOC_PLACE
label_mapping.note: a LOC without a digit (a town, an admin unit): ADDRESS inside an address

label_mapping.label: POSTAL
label_mapping.note: ADDRESS inside an address; a postcode on its own is policy-excluded

label_mapping.label: REGON
label_mapping.note: a business register number identifies a business

label_mapping.label: VIN
label_mapping.note: a vehicle identification number: pii-guard has no type for it

merge_rule: adjacent spans of one mapped type separated by <= 3 spaces/tabs/commas
notes: Synthetic, generated with exhaustive annotation; every identifier is fictional.
Its card asks that it never be trained on: training/ner/decontam.py drops near-duplicates of it from any training file.
pii-guard has no Polish language pack: rules run their language-neutral patterns only, so this set measures how far the NER carries an unseen language.
The maintainer also maintains one of the systems it measures (its card says so).
